label: lf-verify-mogas
topic: Independent re-check of the three key claims in lf-mogas.json, plus one more search for fire, flame-retardant or charring work by the Penn design-school researcher
summary: All three key claims hold on re-fetch (2026-11-13), with two caveats. (1) Chitosan self-folding: SUPPORTED; the quoted sentence is verbatim in both the PubMed and Crossref abstracts. (2) "Only fire-related result": PARTLY; the Eggregate abstract quote is verbatim, but "only" is weaker than it reads, because 17 of her 32 Crossref records carry no abstract and no full text was read. (3) No fire terms on the profile page: SUPPORTED, but the stored evidence_quote is the fetch tool's summary, not text from the page, so it should not be presented as a verbatim quote. The extra search found no further fire, flame-retardant or charring publication: a keyword scan of the 32 Crossref records matched only Eggregate, and one web search returned nothing naming her or the lab. OpenAlex full-text search could not be run (the shared free quota was used up; no key was created). Her interest in green fire coatings and the tester shortage still rests only on the seminar account in the brief.

findings.claim: SUPPORTED: Chitosan 3D printing at metre scale; extrusion plus directional toolpathing orients polymer chains and residual stresses drive large-scale folding
findings.value: Quote in lf-mogas.json is verbatim in the abstract. Interface Focus 2024;14(3):20230077, PMID 39081628, 11 authors (first author is the researcher, last is Oxman). 'Hygromorph-like' is the earlier agent's interpretation: the abstract says residual stresses, not moisture response.
findings.source: https://doi.org/10.1098/rsfs.2023.0077 (PubMed efetch PMID 39081628 and Crossref record, both fetched 2026-11-13)
findings.evidence_quote: residual stresses to induce large-scale folding of the resulting structures
findings.confidence: high for the abstract; full text not read

findings.claim: PARTLY: Eggregate abstract is the only fire-related result found in her publications
findings.value: The abstract quote is verbatim and the paper is as described (ACSA 114th Annual Meeting, 2026; authors Amirzehni, Priya Balasubramanian, Weinstein, Mogas-Soldevila). No test standard or regulatory test is named in the abstract. 'Only' is limited: of 32 Crossref records filtered to her name, 15 have an abstract and 17 do not, so the scan covers titles for all and abstracts for under half. No full texts were read.
findings.evidence_quote: demonstrating fire resistance through controlled surface charring
findings.confidence: high that the abstract says this; medium that nothing else exists

findings.claim: SUPPORTED: Fire-retardant coatings and fire-regulation testing do not appear on her profile page
findings.value: Re-fetched page: none of fire, flame, retardant, coating, chitosan, cellulose, regulation, testing appears. 'Char' occurs only inside 'Charles Addams Hall'; a project title 'ChitoFold Biomaterials Self-Shaping' is listed. Caveat: the evidence_quote stored in lf-mogas.json is the fetch tool's own summary sentence, not page text. Direct curl hit a Cloudflare challenge, so this check again relies on the WebFetch model's reading, not a byte-level scan.
findings.source: https://www.design.upenn.edu/people/laia-mogas-soldevila (WebFetch 2026-11-13; curl returned a 'Just a moment...' challenge page)
findings.confidence: medium-high: read through a summarising fetcher, raw HTML not obtained

findings.claim: New search: no additional fire, flame-retardant or charring publication by her was found
findings.value: Regex scan (fire, flame, flamm-, retardan-, charring, combust-, ignit-) over titles and abstracts of the 32 Crossref records hit only Eggregate. The agarose-films paper has 'thermal' in its title (a thermal study, not a fire test; no abstract in Crossref). One web search for her name and lab with fire terms returned nothing naming her or the lab.
findings.source: Crossref query above; WebSearch 'Mogas-Soldevila DumoLab fire resistance OR "flame retardant" OR charring biomaterial' (2026-11-13)
findings.confidence: medium: absence in metadata and one search, not a full-text search; lab project pages, talks, grants and theses were not checked

key_claims: SUPPORTED: Chitosan printed at metre scale with toolpath-directed chain orientation that drives large-scale folding (quote verbatim in PubMed and Crossref abstract, DOI 10.1098/rsfs.2023.0077). 'Hygromorph-like' is interpretation, not in the abstract.

PARTLY: Eggregate (ACSA 2026, DOI 10.35483/acsa.am.114.18) abstract states fire resistance through controlled surface charring (verbatim). It is the only fire hit in my scan, but 17 of 32 Crossref records have no abstract and no full text was read, so 'only' is not established.

SUPPORTED: The Penn profile page contains none of fire, flame, retardant, coating, regulation, testing. The evidence_quote stored for this claim is a tool summary, not a page quote, and should be relabelled.
No further fire, flame-retardant or charring publication by her was found in Crossref metadata or one web search; her fire-coating interest is documented only by the seminar account in the brief.
lay_summary: We re-opened the same sources an earlier helper used to describe a university researcher who prints building materials from natural ingredients.
The claim that her shell-derived prints fold themselves into shape checked out word for word.

The claim that one 2026 paper says a food-waste wall panel resisted fire by charring also checked out, but we cannot be sure it is her only fire result, because many of her papers have no summary online to search.
Her university page really does not mention fire at all.
A fresh search found no other fire work by her, so the fire-coating idea still comes only from what she said at a seminar.

glossary.Chitosan: a natural polymer made from chitin, the tough material in crab and shrimp shells
glossary.Polymer: a material made of long chain-like molecules
glossary.Toolpath: the route the printer nozzle follows while laying down material
glossary.Residual stress: tension left locked inside a material after it dries or cools, which can make it bend
glossary.Hygromorph: a material that changes shape when its moisture level changes
glossary.Charring: forming a black burnt surface layer, which can slow further burning
glossary.Flame retardant: a substance added to a material to make it harder to set alight or slower to burn
glossary.Abstract: the short summary at the top of a research paper
glossary.Crossref: a public index of published papers and their DOIs
glossary.DOI: a permanent ID and web link for a paper
glossary.PubMed: a public index of biomedical papers
glossary.OpenAlex: a free index of research papers that allows searching inside paper text
glossary.Cloudflare challenge: an automatic 'are you a human' check that blocks scripted page downloads
glossary.Regex scan: an automatic search of text for a list of word patterns

could_not_find: Raw HTML of the profile page: curl was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so the keyword check rests on WebFetch's reading of the page.
OpenAlex full-text search for fire terms in her papers: the shared free daily quota was exhausted; no API key was created.
Full text of Eggregate (which fire test, which standard), ChitoFold and RAMUS: not fetched.
Abstracts for 17 of her 32 Crossref records (including Tegula Series, SimbioBrick, ChitoFold, Terrene 2.0): Crossref has none, so fire content there is unchecked.
dumolab.com project pages, her linked full publications page, Google Scholar, grant databases and talk listings: not checked in the time available.
Any public record of her remark about a shortage of people to test materials against fire regulations.
Crossref records beyond the first 80 rows of the fuzzy author query; the earlier 'about 45 items' count was not reproduced (I got 32).
recommendations: In lf-mogas.json, relabel the profile-page evidence_quote as a tool summary rather than a verbatim quote.
Reword 'only fire-related result' to 'only fire-related result in titles and available abstracts (15 of 32 Crossref records have abstracts)'.
Mark 'hygromorph-like' as our interpretation; the abstract attributes folding to residual stresses.
Fix the reproduce note: the Crossref count depends on rows and name filter (32 with rows=80).
Read the Eggregate full paper to see what fire test was run before citing it as fire evidence.
Rerun the OpenAlex full-text search after the quota resets (midnight UTC), or with a key Amit supplies.
